A "how to read this chart" explainer string

Source: R/i18n.R
lap_howto.Rd

Looks up howto_<builder> in the string registry (see lap_tr()) and fills the {recharge} / {discharge} / {below} / {above} colour placeholders from the design tokens of variant, so the prose colour-matches the plot. The plot builders call this for their default plot.caption; call it directly to place the explainer elsewhere.

Usage

lap_howto(builder, lang = NULL, variant = NULL, ...)

Arguments

builder

Builder name without the lap_plot_ prefix, e.g. "hex_map".

lang

Language code; defaults to lap_lang().

variant

"light" / "dark"; defaults to lap_variant().

...

Further named {placeholder} values passed to lap_tr().

Value

A single string (may contain <span> markup for ggtext).

Examples

lap_howto("hex_map")
#> [1] "Each hexagon is the average of the monitoring wells that fall inside it; darker cells hold more wells. Empty cells (no wells) are shown in grey."
lap_howto("hex_map", lang = "de")
#> [1] "Jede Wabe ist der Mittelwert der enthaltenen Messstellen; dunklere Zellen enthalten mehr Messstellen. Leere Zellen (keine Messstellen) sind grau dargestellt."
